title: 第一卷 第7章 过三关第一卷 第8章 李寒舟想飞升
slug: 师叔你的法宝太不正经了

太玄圣地的脸是要丢尽了！
“柳东岳……”
太玄圣地大长老看着水月镜花中柳东岳的背影，恨的牙根痒痒。
这祖宗是从哪冒出来的？
他的这种奇奇怪怪的灵宝是从哪来的？
还有那金刚符，到底是什么人画的，竟然能挡住九品四重的盘斧功？
“给我查！”太玄圣地大长老怒喝一声：“给我查查这个叫柳东岳的是从哪来的。”
“是！”
身后的人赶紧去查。
“你们三个，给我好好招呼这个柳东岳！”此时大长老又开口传音给太玄圣地的三个考核弟子。
百枯山。
山脚，山腰，山顶上都分别有一位弟子。
他们三人本来在盘膝打坐，在听到大长老传音之后，都纷纷睁开眼睛，眼神中都带着不解的神色。
柳东岳是谁？
来的人不是他们的师弟陆天行吗？
他们虽然同样是太玄圣地的弟子，但是他们三个的修为却远非陆天行可比，他们三个人都是已经超越了九品的存在，达到了超脱境。
在太玄圣地中也是高手之列。
本来按照剧本，陆天行来到这里，他们三个放放水，让陆天行通过考核，来到山顶，然后将般若斧在所有人的面前赐给陆天行，但是没想到来的竟然不是陆天行。
之前长老有交代过，若是真的发生意外，来的人不是陆天行的话，那就给我往死里招呼。

坚决不能让他拿到般若斧。
整个太玄圣地的广场上的众多宗门也都没有想到最后考核的第一名竟然是一个名不经传的弟子，还只是区区五品。
太讽刺了！
今天太玄圣地的人算是丢大了。
所有人的心中都在幸灾乐祸，他们不介意看到太玄圣地今天将丢人进行到底。
太玄圣地此刻也赶紧安排人到风沙谷去给陆天行送衣服去了。
而与此同时，柳东岳也已经来到了百枯山的山脚下了。
此刻柳东岳的心情尤为兴奋，他怎么都没有想到自己只是来参加考核来的，竟然拿了个第一。
而这个时候，在山脚下，一名太玄圣地的弟子已经等在那里了。
他背后靠着古树，看到迎面走来的柳东岳，不禁一愣。
身上穿着破破烂烂的道袍，并且从真气的境界来判断，眼前这个小子仅仅是五品修为吧？
这样的修为是怎么夺得第一的？
开玩笑吗？
“你就是第一？”那太玄圣地的弟子走上来打量着柳东岳问。
“是，这位师兄，我来接受考核。”柳东岳此刻的心情还没平复下来，略有激动的说。
“呵。”那太玄圣地的弟子冷笑一声：“好啊，那考核就开始吧，按照规矩，我把修为压制到跟你一样，然后你先出手，等三招之后，我再出手！”
“那这位师兄，那就对不住了。”柳东岳抱拳一拜。
“还不一定是谁对不住谁呢，这位师弟，你尽全力出手吧。”那太玄弟子笑了笑。
“那得罪了。”柳东岳自然不可能真的上去和太玄圣地的弟子比拼，那绝对是找死，他能仰仗的，自然就是七宝葫芦了。
这七宝葫芦的功能虽然猥琐，但是真的有用啊！

将人的衣服给吸得溜光，谁也不好意思光着屁股甩着腊肠当着那么多人的面冲上来继续战斗吧？

Taixuan Holy Land is going to be completely disgraced!
"Liu Dongyue..."
The Great Elder of Taixuan Holy Land looked at Liu Dongyue's back in the water-moon mirror, and his teeth itched with hatred.
Where did this ancestor come from?
Where did his strange spiritual treasure come from?
And who drew that diamond talisman, which can actually block the ninth-level, fourth-level axe skill?
"Check it for me!" The Great Elder of Taixuan Holy Land shouted angrily: "Check it for me where this person named Liu Dongyue comes from."
"Yes!"
The people behind him quickly went to check.
"You three, please greet this Liu Dongyue!" At this time, the great elder spoke again and sent a message to the three assessment disciples in Taixuan Holy Land.
Baiku Mountain.
There is a disciple at the foot of the mountain, on the mountainside, and on the top of the mountain.
The three of them were sitting cross-legged and meditating. After hearing the Great Elder's message, they all opened their eyes with puzzled looks in their eyes.
Who is Liu Dongyue?
Isn't the person who came here their junior brother Lu Tianxing?
Although they are also disciples of Taixuan Holy Land, the cultivation of the three of them is far from comparable to that of Lu Tianxing. All three of them have surpassed the existence of the ninth level and reached the realm of transcendence.
He is also among the masters in Taixuan Holy Land.
Originally, according to the script, Lu Tianxing came here, the three of them let Lu Tianxing pass the test, came to the top of the mountain, and then gave the Prajna Ax to Lu Tianxing in front of everyone, but unexpectedly it was not Lu Tianxing who came.
The elders have told me before that if an accident really happens and the person who comes is not Lu Tianxing, then I will send you to death.
We must not let him get the Prajna Axe.
None of the many sects in the square of Taixuan Holy Land expected that the first place in the final assessment would be an unknown disciple, only a fifth-grade disciple.
How ironic!
The people of Taixuan Holy Land were really embarrassed today.
Everyone is gloating in their hearts, and they don't mind seeing Taixuan Holy Land going through the humiliation to the end today.
Taixuan Holy Land also quickly arranged for people to go to Fengsha Valley to deliver clothes to Lu Tianxing.
At the same time, Liu Dongyue had also arrived at the foot of Baiku Mountain.
Liu Dongyue was particularly excited at this moment. He never thought that he just came to take the assessment and actually got the first place.
At this time, at the foot of the mountain, a disciple from Taixuan Holy Land was already waiting there.
He leaned against the ancient tree behind him and couldn't help but be startled when he saw Liu Dongyue coming towards him.
Wearing tattered Taoist robes, and judging from the state of Qi, the boy in front of him is only a fifth-grade cultivation, right?
How did you achieve first place with such a level of cultivation?
Are you kidding?
"Are you number one?" The disciple from Taixuan Holy Land came up and looked at Liu Dongyue and asked.
"Yes, this senior brother, I'm here to take the assessment." Liu Dongyue said slightly excitedly before he calmed down.
"Ha." The disciple from the Taixuan Holy Land sneered: "Okay, let's start the assessment. According to the rules, I will suppress my cultivation to the same level as you, and then you will make the first move, and after three moves, I will make the move!"
"Then this senior brother, I can't help it." Liu Dongyue cupped his fists and bowed.
"It's not necessarily who can't resist whom. Junior brother, please try your best to take action." The Taixuan disciple smiled.
"That's offending." It was naturally impossible for Liu Dongyue to really compete with the disciples of Taixuan Holy Land. That would definitely be courting death. The only one he could rely on was the Seven Treasure Gourd.
Although the function of this seven treasure gourd is wretched, it is really useful!
After sucking people's clothes off, no one would be embarrassed to rush up to them with their butts bare and swinging sausages in front of so many people, right?
